name: John Sawyer
role: Bad Lands cowhand from Oak Bay, New Brunswick
bio: John Sawyer was named at the Little Missouri River Stockmen's Association meeting in April 1885 and dislocated his shoulder that October. In October 1886 he left for a winter at his old home in Oak Bay, New Brunswick, and the paper called him too good a cowpuncher to lose.

moments.label: Left for a winter visit to New Brunswick
